bio.text: Chris Henry, also known as Kit, is a candidate for U.S. Senate in Oregon in the November 3, 2026 general election, listed with the Pacific Green Party of Oregon and the Progressive Party.
Ballotpedia reports he graduated from UAW Trade School in 1985 and has worked as a community advocate, union truck driver and aircraft mechanic.
It also reports he has been affiliated with Honest Elections Oregon.
